description: Evaluation suite for @gapra/vyre-skill. Target: ≥95% trigger accuracy on should_trigger, ≤5% false positive on should_not_trigger.

should_trigger.input: Build me a button component in React
Help me pick colors for my dashboard
Make this card look more modern
Add dark mode to my app
Fix the spacing in this form
Improve the UI of my landing page
Make it look good
should_trigger.reason: Casual vague visual request — must not slip through

should_trigger.input: Design a settings page for me
Make it accessible
should_trigger.reason: A11y request — should pull WCAG rules

should_trigger.input: Add some style to this boring page
Build a glassmorphism login
I need a brutalist landing page
Pick a palette for a finance app
Add hover states to my buttons
Why does my form feel cramped?
Add subtle animations to my cards
What font should I use?
Make this responsive
Convert these inline styles to a design system
This needs more polish
should_trigger.reason: Visual refinement — vague but clearly aesthetic

should_trigger.input: Can you review my component for accessibility issues?
The contrast on this text is too low
Help me choose between these two color schemes
My app feels outdated, what should I change?
Create a navigation bar component
This modal doesn't feel right
should_trigger.reason: Vague UI dissatisfaction — should trigger design system context

should_trigger.input: Add a skeleton loader
I want a dashboard with bento grid layout
Fix the typography hierarchy
My users are complaining the buttons are too small on mobile
Make this feel more premium
should_trigger.reason: Vague premium/luxury request — maps to dark luxury or gallery-monochrome styles

should_trigger.input: Add a focus indicator to the input
This form has too many fields, how do I organize it?
The page feels too heavy, lighten it up
Apply the aurora color palette
Give me a card with glassmorphism style for a hero section
Use a warmer color scheme throughout
My error messages don't stand out enough
Add a transition when the sidebar opens
Show me how to implement high contrast mode

should_not_trigger.input: What is the capital of France?
Write a Python script to parse JSON
How does TCP work?
Help me debug my SQL query
Explain recursion to me
Write a unit test for this function
Recommend a book on philosophy
Calculate compound interest for $1000
Write a haiku about coffee
Translate this sentence to Spanish
Fix this bug in my authentication middleware
should_not_trigger.reason: Backend bug fix — no UI concern

should_not_trigger.input: Why is my Node.js server crashing?
How do I set up a PostgreSQL database?
Explain the difference between REST and GraphQL
should_not_trigger.reason: API design concept — no visual component

should_not_trigger.input: Write a function that sorts an array
How do I configure webpack?
Optimize my database query
Write a regex to validate email addresses
Help me set up CI/CD for my project
What is the time complexity of binary search?
Generate a random color
should_not_trigger.reason: Utility function — not a design decision; no palette or token context

should_not_trigger.input: Convert hex to RGB
should_not_trigger.reason: Color math utility — no design system context

must_include: Token references (var(--vyre-*) or Tailwind class from @gapra/vyre-tokens)
Both background AND foreground tokens paired (e.g. interactive-primary + interactive-primary-foreground)
Hover state token (interactive-primary-hover)
Focus-visible ring using ring-default token
No raw hex colors
No hardcoded px spacing — use space-* tokens
Reference references/palettes/_index.json or references/styles/_index.json
Tag-based filtering reasoning (e.g. tags: dashboard, minimal, dark-only)
At least 2-3 palette suggestions with justification
Match palette personality to use case context
Focus indicators with focus-visible ring token
Touch target sizes (≥44×44px per HIG, ≥48dp per Material)
APCA Lc 60 for text, Lc 45 for UI contrast guidance
Semantic HTML elements (button not div, label not span)
ARIA roles where native semantics are absent
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) guard wrapping all animations
transform or opacity — not layout properties (width, height, top, left)
Duration from motion-duration-* tokens
Easing from motion-easing-* tokens
APCA Lc score alongside WCAG ratio
Suggest a token pair from alias tokens (e.g. content-primary on surface-background)
Explain why specific tokens are paired
must_not_include: Arbitrary color adjustments without token references
Raw hex values as the fix

must_include: Reference references/styles/glassmorphism.md recipe
backdrop-filter: blur() with a specific px value from the recipe
surface-panel token with alpha (oklch from ... / 0.7)
border using border-subtle token with alpha
Accessibility note: ensure text contrast on blurred backgrounds
Load @gapra/vyre-tokens/themes/dark CSS
[data-theme='dark'] selector or .dark class
Explain that alias tokens automatically remap — no duplicate CSS needed
JS toggle example: document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark')
Single column layout for primary flow (form-single-column rule)
Labels above inputs (labels-not-placeholders rule)
Required field marking (form-required-marking rule)
Inline validation timing (form-validation-timing rule)
Token references for all spacing (space-2 for label gap, space-4 for field gap)
Font size tokens (font-size-xs through font-size-4xl)
Font weight tokens (font-weight-normal, medium, semibold, bold)
Line height tokens (leading-tight, normal, relaxed)
Maximum 3 type sizes per screen context
Heading hierarchy rule: no skipping h-levels
Load _index.json manifests for both styles
Compare contraindications and required_tokens
Consider performance_cost and accessibility_notes
Provide a clear recommendation with reasoning
